conclusion_future_work: This made me realise that accessibility is not only about physical spaces or technology, but also about communication and understanding individual differences.As a Creative Technology student, I think this is something worth considering in my future projects. When designing interactive experiences, I should not only focus on how the technology works, but also think about who can participate and whether the experience is accessible to different people.
results_discussion: An Access Rider is a document that allows individuals to communicate their needs and preferences to help them participate in activities, learning, or working environments. Before this class, I had never heard of it, so I found it interesting to learn how different people's needs can be considered and respected.
title: creative industry research - week 1
introduction: In the first week, we were introduced to practice-based research and the creative industries. One concept that was completely new to me was the Access Rider.
